cases.purpose: With module signature enforcement switched on at runtime, bashkmod load of an unsigned and of a tampered module reports the kernel's rejection (EKEYREJECTED) with status 1 and the strerror text, exactly like a direct finit_module call, and the shipped signed module still loads
cases.oracle: A direct finit_module(2) call through ctypes on the same file (kernel verdict and strerror text), before and after sig_enforce is set to Y through /sys/module/module/parameters/sig_enforce
cases.comparison: For signed, signature-stripped and payload-tampered copies of the shipped nbd module, before and after enforcement: the oracle's errno name versus the candidate's status and diagnostic text, and whether the module stayed loaded.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 0 && $EUID == 0 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
sig() { /usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-kmod-sig.py "$@"; }
has() { local n; while read -r n _; do [[ $n == "$1" ]] && return 0; done </proc/modules; return 1; }
D=/tmp/parity-case
read -r se </sys/module/module/parameters/sig_enforce; echo "sig_enforce-before=$se"
sig prep "$D"
try3() {
  local ph=$1 f o c rc
  for f in signed unsigned tampered; do
    o=$(sig try "$D/$f.ko"); c=$(bashkmod load "$D/$f.ko" 2>&1); rc=$?
    if [[ $o == OK ]]; then ok=$([[ $rc == 0 && -z $c ]] && echo 1 || echo 0); has nbd && bashkmod unload nbd
    else ok=$([[ $rc == 1 && $c == "load: $D/$f.ko: ${o#*|}" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0); fi
    echo "$ph $f: oracle=${o%%|*} candidate-agrees=$ok still-loaded=$(has nbd && echo 1 || echo 0)"
  done
}
try3 before-enforce
echo "enforce: $(sig enforce)"
try3 enforced
cases.stdout:
sig_enforce-before=N
shipped-module-signed=1 unsigned-differs=1
before-enforce signed: oracle=OK candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
before-enforce unsigned: oracle=OK candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
before-enforce tampered: oracle=EKEYREJECTED candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
enforce: Y
enforced signed: oracle=OK candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
enforced unsigned: oracle=EKEYREJECTED candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
enforced tampered: oracle=EKEYREJECTED candidate-agrees=1 still-loaded=0
